attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates household employment taxes per Schedule H. Includes employer's share of Social Security (6.2%), Medicare (1.45%), and FUTA (6.0% on first $7,000 per employee). Only applies to employees with wages above threshold ($2,700 for FICA, $1,000 for FUTA).
